bone_pile.look: a small PILE OF BONES: a heap of pale chalky-white bones - a skull, a few ribs and long bones - jumbled together.

cave_moss.look: a flat patch of CAVE MOSS: an irregular smear of soft blue-green glowing moss and lichen on the rock floor, darker at the edges.

chest_mossy.look: an old MOSSY TREASURE CHEST: a weathered wooden chest with a rounded lid and dark iron bands, partly covered in green MOSS, a hint of gold under the lid.

crystal_large.look: a large CRYSTAL formation: a tall cluster of pointed purple-and-blue prisms of varying height on a chunky rock base, bright facet glints.

crystal_quartz.look: a QUARTZ cluster in rock: a group of clear milky-white six-sided prisms with pale blue-grey shadows and sharp facet glints, on a grey stone base.

crystal_small.look: a small CRYSTAL cluster: a few short pointed amethyst-purple prisms jutting up from a rocky base, with bright glints on the facets.

geode.look: a GEODE: a roundish grey rock split open to reveal a hollow lined with sparkling purple crystals.

mine_cart.look: a metal MINE CART seen front-on: an open rectangular iron ore cart on four small wheels, half-full of grey ore and rock. Clearly a mine cart.

mine_rail.look: a straight section of MINE RAIL TRACK seen from above: two parallel metal rails on wooden cross-ties (sleepers) running LEFT-TO-RIGHT across the tile, the rails bleeding off both side edges so sections connect into one track.

mine_support.look: a wooden MINE SUPPORT: a rough-hewn timber frame like a doorway - two vertical posts and a horizontal cross-beam - bracing a tunnel.

mining_bucket.look: a wooden mining BUCKET with an iron handle, half full of grey ore chunks.

ore_pile.look: a loose PILE OF ORE: a low heap of chunky grey rocks flecked with copper-orange and iron glints.

ore_sack.look: a burlap ORE SACK: a tied tan cloth sack, bulging, with a few chunks of grey ore spilling from the open top.

powder_keg.look: a POWDER KEG: a stout wooden barrel banded with iron, a red explosive marking on the front and a short fuse on top.

rubble.look: a pile of mining RUBBLE: a low heap of broken angular grey rocks and pebbles of mixed sizes.

tnt.look: a stick of mining TNT: a bundle of three bright RED dynamite sticks bound together with a short lit fuse on top. Clearly explosive, not a candle.

tool_rack.look: a wooden TOOL RACK: an upright frame holding mining tools - a pickaxe, a shovel and a hammer hanging in a row.

wheelbarrow.look: a metal WHEELBARROW seen front-on: a single-wheel barrow with a grey tub, two handles, half-full of rock and ore.
